create_callback_early_stopping: create an EarlyStoppingCallback that halts training when a metric stops improving after N evaluations
build_callback_handler: build a CallbackHandler that manages and dispatches TrainerCallback events to registered callbacks in order
create_trainer_state_json: create a TrainerState and save it to JSON for checkpointing and restoring training state
create_trainer_control: create a TrainerControl to signal whether training, saving, evaluation, or logging should proceed
create_progress_callback: create a ProgressCallback that displays tqdm progress bars and formatted log output during training
